title: RenderFormer-V2: Neural Rendering with Heterogeneous Scene Primitives
abstract: arXiv:2609.05738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present 'RenderFormer-V2', a unified learned transformer-based neural rendering model, complementary to modern physics-based rendering systems, that can handle diverse light-transport effects such as caustics, volumetric scattering, environment lighting, textured and displaced surfaces and out-of-distribution materials without per-scene training or specialized code. RenderFormer-V2 models global light transport as a sequence-to-sequence transformation. Following its predecessor, RenderFormer-V2 also employs a two stage process: a view-independent stage that resolves intra-scene primitive to primitive transport, and a view-dependent stage that transforms the internal neural scene representation into image pixels. Different from RenderFormer, our model employs a novel combined windowed-attention and rendering-informed attention sink in the view-independent stage to improve scalability while maintaining render accuracy. translated_title: RenderFormer-V2：基于异构场景基元的神经渲染
translated_abstract: 我们提出了"RenderFormer-V2"，这是一个统一的、基于Transformer的神经渲染学习模型，与现代基于物理的渲染系统互补，能够处理多种光传输效果，如焦散、体积散射、环境光照、带纹理和位移的表面以及分布外材质，而无需针对每个场景进行训练或专门的代码。RenderFormer-V2将全局光传输建模为序列到序列的转换。与其前身一样，RenderFormer-V2也采用两阶段流程：一个与视角无关的阶段，用于解析场景内基元到基元之间的传输；一个与视角相关的阶段，将内部神经场景表示转换为图像像素。与RenderFormer不同，我们的模型在与视角无关的阶段中采用了新颖的窗口注意力与渲染信息注意力池相结合的机制，在保持渲染精度的同时提升了可扩展性。
tldr: RenderFormer-V2是一个无需针对每个场景训练的统一Transformer神经渲染模型，通过在视角无关阶段引入窗口注意力与渲染信息注意力池相结合的新机制，在保持渲染精度的同时提升可扩展性，并能处理焦散、体积散射、环境光照等多样化全局光传输效果。
en_tdlr: RenderFormer-V2 is a unified transformer-based neural rendering model that handles diverse light-transport effects without per-scene training, employing a novel combined windowed-attention and rendering-informed attention sink in its view-independent stage to improve scalability while maintaining render accuracy.
